---
mode: agent
description: Review a VEIL CIRCUIT gameplay feature for player feel, clarity and low-end Android behavior.
---

Review the feature from the player's perspective on a 4 GB Android phone.

Inspect:
- Touch target size, input conflicts, camera response, movement consistency and pause behavior.
- Readability of objectives, hacking state, detection feedback, alert escalation and failure/retry flow.
- Guard perception, patrol/investigation state transitions and deterministic reset behavior.
- Animation/feedback timing, sound cues and accessibility/readability.
- CPU/GPU cost, draw calls, shader cost, memory, loading and frame pacing.

Give a prioritized findings list with file/symbol evidence and concrete acceptance criteria. Do not recommend adding content before the current loop is reliable. Separate source review from actual device testing.
